set firewall family inet filter ACL-3001.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term 1.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

then accept.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the NAT rule book.

rule NAT1.explanation: This command configures a source NAT rule within a specified rule-set, defining how traffic matching the rule is translated before leaving the network.

match source-address 192.168.10.0/24.explanation: Configures the source address that the NAT rules match.
